abstract: We establish support-restricted asymptotic density upper bounds strictly below 9/5 = 1.8 for the maximum size of a subset without three collinear points in four-level axis-aligned modular hyperbola unions across all center phases (x_0, y_0) in F_p^2 (Open Cell 10 of no_three_in_line_35 v8). In Version 1, 1D difference-phase binning certified 34 of the 57 collision isomorphism classes globally across [0, 1/2]^2. In this Version 2, we resolve all reviewer items and extend global certification to 39 of the 57 classes (68.4%) across [0, 1/2]^2, completing 100% of all 38 classes with additive-triple count T(C) <= 3, together with (-4, -2, -1, 1) (T(C) = 4). We prove Proposition 2 (Active-Root vs. Binned-Difference Tradeoff on C & D), establishing that 1D conditional independence requires |C_act| <= 4 - k_b. To overcome this constraint, we prove Diagonal Reflection Duality and 1D Exterior Cross Reduction (Theorem 5): vertical reflection maps H_p(C; x_0, y_0) to H_p(-C; x_0, p - 1 - y_0) while swapping (t_+, t_-) <-> (t_-, t_+) up to an O(1/p) shift. In Theorem 6, we establish the Unified Scalar Representation across both antipodal parity sheets sigma(A, B) in {0, 1}, proving pointwise nested root survival and first-order stochastic dominance under pure conditional mutual independence. Exact rational certificates across both parity sheets verify all 5 target classes globally (Theorem 7, Table 2) and certify all 20 classes with T(C) <= 5 on the interior peak square [13/40, 7/20]^2 strictly below 1.8 (Theorem 8, Table 3), while establishing verified upper bounds under 4-bin conditional independence for the 3 classes with T(C) in {6, 7}.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: This Version 2 incorporates all precision improvements and feedback from the review reports: (1) Replaced Proposition 2's impossibility claim with the exact combinatorial active-root vs. binned-difference tradeoff (|C_act| <= 4 - k_b), demonstrating how 2D root binning allows simultaneous conditioning of root coordinates while retaining all 4 active roots. (2) Withdrawn all anchor-root vs. spanning-cycle dichotomy and necessity claims, presenting Table 3 strictly as verified finite certification upper bounds under 4-bin conditional independence. (3) Corrected Theorem 6(2) to state the two separate valid envelope chains, and corrected Theorem 6(5) to the exact discrete pair-sum upper-tail convolution identity. (4) Added the O(1/p) finite-grid reflection note in Theorem 5(2) and closed missing delimiter tokens in Proposition 1 and Theorem 2(1). (5) Optimized the standalone 2D verifier verify_2d_rootbin_four_hyperbolas.py with canonical color-ID deduplication and integer weight scaling, reducing cold execution time to ~51s. (6) In Theorems 5-8 and Tables 2-3, certified 5 additional classes globally across [0, 1/2]^2 and both antipodal parity sheets sigma in {0, 1}, completing global all-center sub-1.8 certification for 39 of the 57 classes (100% of all 38 classes with T(C) <= 3, plus (-4, -2, -1, 1)), and certifying all 20 classes with T(C) <= 5 strictly below 1.8 on the interior peak square [13/40, 7/20]^2.
title: Concentric-Threshold Equivalence, Diagonal Reflection Duality, Antipodal Parity Sheets, and All-Center Sub-9/5 Asymptotic Bounds for 39 Four-Hyperbola Classes Completing All T(C) <= 3
